name: duopore-public-delivery-quantity-reconcile
description: Compare what you expected with what arrived and spot short, extra or damaged items.

interface.longDescription: Compare what you expected with what arrived and spot short, extra or damaged items. Enter expected quantities by product code, plus accepted and damaged units received. See gaps and product codes you did not expect. Damaged units do not count as accepted stock. This checks your records; it does not inspect goods or make a courier claim.
defaultPrompt: Compare this delivery with the quantities I expected.
Show shortages, extra units and damaged items by product code.

positive.prompt: Use Delivery Quantity Reconcile with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"expected":[{"sku":"001","units":10},{"sku":"002","units":2}],"receipts":[{"receiptId":"01","sku":"001","receivedUnits":9,"damagedUnits":1},{"receiptId":"02","sku":"003","receivedUnits":1,"damagedUnits":0}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts.
